title: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS approved Road Train Bullbar #34
description: Kenworth T610 SAR high tensile polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar. Texas style channel. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Heavy duty tow pin and high tensile aluminium backing plate. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs and fold down Over Size signs. Combination daylight running/indicator LED lights in outer posts. Extended box uprights to the base of the main channel. One piece pipes through drilled heavy hi-tensile box uprights. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
